title: Eradicating Social Biases in Sentiment Analysis using Semantic Blinding and Semantic Propagation Graph Neural Networks

bias_targets.methodology: Fitting linear regression models and using permutation tests to analyze whether the model's predicted sentiment (valence) for text stimuli containing politicians' names is systematically influenced by their political party affiliation.

Fitting linear regression models and using permutation tests to evaluate if the model's predicted sentiment (valence) for text stimuli containing politicians' names is systematically influenced by the politicians' gender.
